What this is

A fake, zoomed-in acre. Four potential landmines sit on lattice points taken from the user’s example coordinates. Visit order comes from the preexisting robot mission queue in dist/robot/next_mission.json: higher expected_find is more important; earlier queue index breaks ties. The dog never occupies a mine cell — BFS stops on a 4-neighbour.
